description: Run and review AI evidence assessments (editor+, async): assess a file or many, assess a window or many, refresh stale windows, confirm or override verdicts, set window acceptance.

ao_overrides.description: Objectives to re-designate — required (≥1) when overriding, forbidden when confirming; unlisted objectives keep the AI's designation. 422 if the version has no per-objective answers: confirm instead Used by: review_file_verdict, review_window_verdict.

assess_unassessed.description: Also assess every file that has no existing assessment (default false) Used by: assess_files_bulk.

assessment_id.description: Window assessment UUID — obtain from scf_get_assessment_review_queue (window_assessment_id) or scf_list_window_assessments Used by: review_window_verdict.

assessment_source.description: Origin tag for the request (default on_demand) Used by: assess_file, assess_window.

decision.description: confirmed = AI verdict stands; overridden = you are changing it Used by: review_file_verdict, review_window_verdict.

evidence_id.description: Evidence ID (e.g., 'ERL-IAM-001') — obtain from scf_list_evidence [assess_file] | Evidence ID — assesses every file under this evidence item [assess_files_bulk] | Catalog evidence ID the file belongs to, e.g. E-IAM-01 [review_file_verdict] | Evidence ID (e.g., 'E-IAM-01'). Tracking row with a frequency must exist — set via scf_update_evidence first [assess_window] Used by: assess_file, assess_files_bulk, review_file_verdict, assess_window.

evidence_ids.description: Evidence IDs to assess (e.g., ['E-IAM-01','E-BCM-11']); 1–25 per request Used by: assess_windows_bulk.

ewa_id.description: Window assessment UUID — obtain from scf_list_window_assessments Used by: review_window.

file_id.description: Evidence file UUID — obtain from scf_list_evidence_files Used by: assess_file, review_file_verdict.

file_ids.description: Specific evidence file UUIDs to assess Used by: assess_files_bulk.

method.description:
assess_file: Queue an AI assessment of one evidence file (write — editor+, async); poll scf_get_evidence_assessment. Judged against the catalogue's mapped controls, which may include controls not in scope.
assess_files_bulk: Queue AI assessments for multiple evidence files (write — editor+ role, async, max 50). Provide evidence_id, file_ids, and/or assess_unassessed. Returns count queued.
review_file_verdict: Record a human decision on a file's current AI assessment (write — editor role). confirmed keeps the verdict; overridden needs a reason and at least one objective re-designation.
assess_window: Queue a windowed AI assessment of every file in the item's frequency window as one portfolio (write — editor+, async). 422 without tracking/frequency. Judged against catalogue-mapped controls.
assess_windows_bulk: Queue windowed AI assessments for up to 25 evidence IDs (write — editor+ role, async). Items without tracking or a frequency set are reported under `skipped_detail` in the response.
refresh_stale_windows: Queue a fresh windowed AI assessment for every evidence item whose newest file postdates its last assessment (write — editor role). Capped per run; returns how many were queued.
review_window: Set a windowed assessment's acceptance review (write — editor): approved, rejected (raises a deficiency per in-scope control), needs_revision, or not_reviewed to revoke.
review_window_verdict: Confirm or override a window's current AI verdict (write — editor role). overridden needs a reason and ≥1 objective re-designation. One decision per version; 422 without objectives: confirm.

reason.description: Why the verdict is overridden — required when decision is overridden Used by: review_file_verdict, review_window_verdict.

review_status.description: Review state to set; not_reviewed revokes Used by: review_window.

name: scf_assessment_write
